title.zh: Ondo Finance 推出私募市场代币化产品，首个标的为 OpenAI
title.en: Ondo Finance推出私募市场链上代币化产品，首个标的为AI领域Pre-IPO公司

current_state.zh: Ondo Private Markets 已上线 OpenAI 私募市场票据，在 Ondo Perps 现货订单簿提供 7x24 小时链上交易，面向合格投资者提供与 OpenAI 参考每股价值挂钩的经济敞口；该票据不代表 OpenAI 股权，Ondo 与 OpenAI 无关联或背书关系。
current_state.en: Ondo Private Markets has listed an OpenAI private markets note, offering 24/7 on-chain trading on the Ondo Perps spot orderbook to qualified investors for economic exposure tied to OpenAI's reference per-share value; the note does not represent OpenAI equity and Ondo has no affiliation or endorsement relationship with OpenAI.

updates.title_zh: Ondo Finance推出私募市场链上代币化产品，首个标的为AI领域Pre-IPO公司
updates.title_en: Ondo Finance推出私募市场链上代币化产品，首个标的为AI领域Pre-IPO公司
updates.what_changed_zh: Ondo Finance推出Ondo Private Markets，这是一款代币化票据产品，提供对顶级私营公司的链上经济敞口，首批为一家AI领域Pre-IPO公司，预计本周开始二级交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Ondo Finance launched Ondo Private Markets, a tokenized-notes product offering on-chain economic exposure to top private companies, beginning with an AI-sector Pre-IPO firm expected to start secondary trading this week.

updates.title_zh: 【Ondo Private Markets 上线 OpenAI 私募市场票据，支持 7x24 小时链上交易】
updates.title_en: 【Ondo Private Markets 上线 OpenAI 私募市场票据，支持 7x24 小时链上交易】
updates.what_changed_zh: Ondo Private Markets 的首个标的被明确为 OpenAI，其私募市场票据已在 Ondo Perps 现货订单簿上线并支持 7x24 小时交易。
updates.what_changed_en: The first underlying of Ondo Private Markets was identified as OpenAI, and its private markets note has been listed on the Ondo Perps spot orderbook with 24/7 trading.
updates.current_state_zh: Ondo Private Markets 已上线 OpenAI 私募市场票据，在 Ondo Perps 现货订单簿提供 7x24 小时链上交易，面向合格投资者提供与 OpenAI 参考每股价值挂钩的经济敞口；该票据不代表 OpenAI 股权，Ondo 与 OpenAI 无关联或背书关系。
updates.current_state_en: Ondo Private Markets has listed an OpenAI private markets note, offering 24/7 on-chain trading on the Ondo Perps spot orderbook to qualified investors for economic exposure tied to OpenAI's reference per-share value; the note does not represent OpenAI equity and Ondo has no affiliation or endorsement relationship with OpenAI.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ondo Private Markets has listed an OpenAI private markets note on its Ondo Perps spot orderbook, offering qualified investors tokenized, self-custodial, 24/7-tradeable economic exposure tied to OpenAI's reference per-share value without any actual equity or affiliation with OpenAI.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ondo Private Markets has listed an OpenAI private markets note on its Ondo Perps spot orderbook, offering qualified investors tokenized, self-custodial, 24/7-tradeable economic exposure tied to OpenAI's reference per-share value without any actual equity or affiliation with OpenAI.
